Expert annotations included (24,447 hours, $262K cost). Key finding: SOTA models (Claude 3.5 Sonnet, o1) lag humans on creativity, criticized for 'lack of soul'. Judge models available: ai-forever/pollux-judge-7b-r and pollux-judge-32b-r. HuggingFace: ai-forever/POLLUX. See annotator_notes.md for detailed criteria. December 2025 paper.

name: CDAT

all.description: Generate 10 mutually dissimilar nouns related to cue word

notes: Conditional Divergent Association Task - evaluates divergent creative thinking through word generation. Task: Generate 10 dissimilar nouns that are each associated with a given cue word. Tests both novelty (how different words are from each other) and appropriateness (how related to cue). Evaluation: Custom metrics using word embeddings (FastText/GloVe) - Appropriateness (similarity to cue), Novelty (pairwise distance), Creativity Score (combined) - see metric_notes.md. 1,000 cue words from Brown corpus downloaded from GitHub. Addresses DAT limitation which only measures novelty. EACL 2026 (Findings). Nakajima et al.

name: LeMat-GenBench (MOF/Crystal Generation)
reason: Materials science evaluation, not creativity
notes: Standardized evaluation framework for crystal generative models. Evaluates thermodynamic viability and scientific validity (stability, novelty, validity) NOT creative quality. Requires specialized materials science software (pymatgen, MLIP ensembles, MACE-MP, UMA, Orb-v3) for crystallographic analysis and energy predictions. Models generate CIF (Crystallographic Information File) format. Metrics: energy above convex hull, charge neutrality, structural fingerprinting. Evaluates 12 generative models on unconditional generation of 2,500 structures. GitHub: LeMaterial/lemat-genbench. Public leaderboard on HuggingFace Spaces. Focuses on scientific correctness not creativity. December 2024.

name: L2M3OF (MOF Structure-Property)
reason: Model paper, not creativity benchmark
notes: Multimodal LLM for Metal-Organic Frameworks (MOFs). Introduces MOF-SPK dataset (133,737 MOF structures from CCDC, 35,000+ publications). Four tasks: property prediction, structure extraction (SMILES), description generation, Q&A. Evaluates scientific understanding and property prediction NOT creative generation. Temporal split (pre-2020 train, post-2022 test). Evaluation: MAE for properties, BLEU/EXACT for structures, GPT-4-mini for head-to-head comparisons. Borderline creativity—focuses on knowledge extraction and prediction rather than creative synthesis. Requires molecular encoders for multimodal components. October 2024.
